_note: TEMPLATE - copy to tokens.json and fill in real tokens. tokens.json is gitignored and NEVER committed; this example is committed so a fresh clone knows the file is required and what shape it takes.
_why: The telemetry plane (Cloudflare) needs a per-client bearer token. Tokens are provisioned on the master: New-StickToken mints a random token, registers its HASH in the D1 'tokens' table via wrangler, and records the raw token HERE keyed by the client's drive-id GUID (drive-id.txt). The server only ever stores the hash, never the raw token.
_it_still_ships_to_sticks: tokens.json is excluded from GIT, not from the stick mirror. It is in $script:MasterConfigFiles so Publish-ConfigToStaging copies it into the staging tree that sticks mirror from. Each stick reads ITS OWN token by matching $script:DriveId against the keys below.
_security: Assume a token is recoverable by anyone holding a stick (sticks auto-unlock in use). That is why a token is LOW-POWER - it can only append and read observations, never delete, never touch config or payload. A misbehaving token is revoked server-side (tokens.enabled=0) and its stick_id added to the client revocation list; re-folding then cleans its observations.
_shape: <drive-id-guid>: { token, label }. 'label' is human-readable (e.g. the LabDeploy-NN stick label, or 'Deployer' for the master). The running instance resolves its own token via $script:DriveId.
